free.title: Free proxies
free.riskTitle: Read this before using free proxies
free.riskBody: A significant share of public proxies exist to intercept traffic. Your logged-in sessions are the asset at risk: signing into a valuable account through someone else's free proxy hands that session to its operator. These addresses also appear in reputation databases, which is a stronger fraud signal than any fingerprint mismatch.
free.riskScope: That is why proxies from this tab can only be assigned to a profile with session saving disabled and empty storage. This tab is for checking that the application works, not for working with accounts.
free.directNotice: Requests to sources and proxy checks run over your direct connection — traffic comes from your real IP address.
free.noSources: No sources configured. Paste a list of addresses below in host:port format.
free.rejectedTransparent: Transparent proxies are rejected unconditionally: they expose your real address to the target site.
paid.notice: The links below are affiliate links — the project receives a commission for referrals. The order is not determined by commission size; providers are sorted by suitability for multi-profile work.
paid.datacenterWarning: Mostly datacenter subnets — higher likelihood of blocks
quality.staleWarning: Checked more than an hour ago — a public proxy rarely survives that long
assign.refused.session_persisted: This profile has session saving enabled. A test proxy can only be used with a profile that stores nothing.
assign.refused.storage_not_empty: This profile already holds session data. A test proxy can only be assigned to an empty profile.
assign.refused.credentials_unavailable: Windows secure storage is unavailable, so the password cannot be saved.
selfcheck.intent: The tool looks for mismatches between what the profile claims and what the page actually sees. It is not an anonymity score — optimising for someone else's score is how you end up detectable.
profiles.backupHint: Encrypted with your password, includes cookies and logins. Unlike Windows secure storage, such a copy can be restored on another machine.
profiles.intent: Rename, recolor, duplicate, reset or delete a profile. Changes to a profile that is already open take effect after relaunch.
profiles.resetConfirm: Erase all storage for "{name}" (cookies, local data, logins)? This cannot be undone.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete profile "{name}"? Its stored data is not deleted and stays on disk.
profiles.restoreHint: Creates a new profile from an .mfbackup file, together with its cookies and logins.
profiles.persistSessionConfirm: Changing this reloads the frame and discards its current state (open tabs, in-memory data). Continue?
geoip.title: Local geo/ASN database (MaxMind GeoLite2)
geoip.notice: Determines the country of each proxy's exit IP so a profile's timezone, locale and Accept-Language can match it automatically. Uses your own free MaxMind account — get a license key at maxmind.com. The database downloads to this device only; nothing except the request to MaxMind's official download server leaves the app.
geoip.licenseKeyPlaceholder: Paste your free GeoLite2 license key
geoip.saveError: Could not save the key — Windows secure storage is unavailable.
update.restartHint: Version {version} is ready. Restarts the app now to install it.

profiles.proxy.testFailed: Could not connect through this proxy.
